summary: Retest of the iter22 team/member security fixes. FIX 1 (member owner-only notes in AI Settings, owner still sees the full controls), FIX 3 (member billing UI disabled, checkout and seller-voice POST/DELETE return 403 for members, owner checkout returns 503 'not set up', seller_voice_text locked for members) and FIX 4 (duplicate-email register doesn't use up the rate limit) all PASS. FIX 2 FAILED at first: kicking a member on the Products page still caused an unhandled 'Request failed with status code 401', and the Emergent error overlay blocked login-submit-btn. I found the cause and fixed it in lib/auth.js. After the fix, all 9 kick scenarios pass with no page errors: team removal x6 (products, inbox, orders, channels, settings, plus products->inbox) and plan set to starter x2 (products, settings). Regression checks pass: admin login with the Businesses nav, owner signup, AI Settings save, and the owner's Channels page.

minor.issue: test_iter22_team_security.py::test_signup_rate_limit_429 is flaky: it failed 2 of about 6 full-file runs and passed when run alone. Likely cause: client_ip() comes from X-Forwarded-For with PROXY_HOPS, and the hop count may vary between ingress paths, so the 10/hour hits get split across different keys. Not caused by the FIX 4 change.

integration_issues.flow: Member kicked -> navigate to Products (FIXED by testing agent)
integration_issues.issue: The 401 interceptor only swallowed errors while rf_token was still in localStorage. ProductsPanel sends /billing and /products at the same time on mount. The first 401 cleared the token, so the second 401 failed the check and was rejected with Promise.reject. ProductsPanel.load() has no .catch, so the rejection went unhandled, the Emergent overlay appeared, and login-submit-btn could not be clicked.

action_items: Review the interceptor fix in frontend/src/lib/auth.js. It now checks e.config.headers.Authorization, so any 401 on a request that carried a token is swallowed with a never-settling promise. Only the first one clears the token and sets the notice.

Edge case to consider: a stale request from the old session that returns 401 after the user has signed in again would sign out the new session. Fix: compare the request's Authorization header with the current token before clearing.
Still recommended (from iter22): add .catch to loaders such as ProductsPanel.load as defence in depth.
Make test_signup_rate_limit_429 robust, or check client_ip/PROXY_HOPS under the ingress (flaky).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js interceptor: the old guard `localStorage.getItem('rf_token')` had a race with parallel requests. Fixed as described above.

Backend owner_only is applied correctly on /billing/checkout and both /settings/seller-voice routes. OWNER_FIELDS includes seller_voice_text and is checked in PUT /settings (a member's 'HACKED' value was not saved).

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 new, 14/14 iter22 with 1 flaky rate-limit test)
success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (before fix: FIX 2 failed on Products)

seed_data_creation: Used seed_iter22_ui.py (cleaned up afterwards). The test_it23* users and businesses were removed and db.rate_hits was cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_iter23_member_fixes.py -n 0. The checkout body is {item: 'pro'|'starter'|'business'|'topup'}. For the UI, run python tests/seed_iter22_ui.py (and 'cleanup' afterwards). Kick test: log in as the member, use the owner token to PUT /settings with allowed_emails=[] (or admin POST /admin/businesses/{bid}/plan with starter), then click nav-products etc. and expect login-error and no pageerror. If a test aborts, restore allowed_emails, or the member can't log in.
rca of the issue: Repro: log in as member -> Billing -> owner removes the member -> click nav-products -> pageerror 'Request failed with status code 401' and the overlay blocks the login button. Root cause: parallel 401s; the second one failed the interceptor guard because the first had already removed rf_token. Mitigation: the guard now checks that the failed request carried an Authorization header, and the token removal/notice is done once.
